edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Eclipse answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Blitzcrank Q (20s down to 16s at rank 5): the hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Eclipse answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - His R (60/40/20s) silences on activation — spend your own R on swing moments only, before his is up.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: A whiffed Rocket Grab is 20 seconds of no answer — that's your window to E-Q in, not a moment later.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Pre-casting your R while his Static Field is up risks a silence mid-cast — wait for his R to go on cooldown before you commit yours.
Read the E wind-up, not the cast
Power Fist charges before it swings — the wind-up on his next auto is the tell for the knockup, so back off then, not after it lands.
Bank your escape past his R
Static Field silences on activation — a Flash or spell-based escape queued into his R window just doesn't cast. Get out before he can press it, not during.
